maintenanceCapex.estimate: Depreciation ($250.5M, mostly lease and rental fleet) used as maintenance capex proxy, scaled with revenue in stress. Fleet purchases were $289.6M.

caveats: JUDGMENT, floorplan: Rush does not disclose floorplan interest in dollars, so the dealer convention (deduct floorplan interest from EBITDA, leave floorplan out of debt) cannot be applied. Applied the other consistent pairing instead: floorplan ($918.0M) is in debt and its interest stays in debt service. Leverage reads higher than under the convention.
NOTE, all non-floorplan funded debt ($274.9M) finances the lease and rental fleet.
NOTE, debt maturities in the tagged table exclude finance leases and floorplan.
